detail.longDescription: the archival materials you can find online are just incredible. for example, here is a full copy of a report prepared by the bechtel corporation in 1965 called "fertilizer for india": https:// thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/0 88040125349852222-0560011965/original/WorldBankGroupArchivesfolder1850947.pdf it's basically a pitch to build bechtel fertilizer plants in india. india didn't go for it. 😅 # research # archives # india # fertilizer # history
